# mux_live_stream_simulcast_target (Resource)

A simulcast target of a live stream: a third-party service Mux restreams the broadcast to. Mux only adds or removes a target while the live stream is idle, so an apply during a broadcast fails. Changing any argument replaces the target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "restream_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "mux_live_stream" "channel" {
  title = "Main channel"
}

resource "mux_live_stream_simulcast_target" "restream" {
  live_stream_id = mux_live_stream.channel.id
  url            = "rtmp://live.example.com/app"
  stream_key     = var.restream_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `live_stream_id` (String) ID of the live stream, e.g. `mux_live_stream.example.id`.
- `url` (String) RTMP(S) or SRT endpoint of the destination. For RTMP it includes the application name, e.g. `rtmp://live.example.com/app`.

### Optional

- `passthrough` (String) Arbitrary metadata for the target.
- `stream_key` (String, Sensitive) The destination's stream key, for RTMP(S) only. It is stored in the state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Simulcast target ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <live_stream_id>/<simulcast_target_id>.
terraform import mux_live_stream_simulcast_target.restream ZEBrNTpHC02iUah025KM3te6ylM7W4S4silsrFtUkn3Ag/vuOfW021mz5QA500wYEQ9SeUYvuYnpFz011mqSvski5T8claN02JN9ve2g
```
